_source: USAGov state election office directory (https://www.usa.gov/election-office) and vote.gov
_method: National directory used as the default target for every state. Per-state deep links live in `states` and are only ever SHOWN to a user after link_check.py has confirmed they resolve — see `states` note below.
_note: A dead link on 'here is how to see your real ballot', during election week, from a link Civitas vouched for, is the worst failure this feature has. So per-state URLs are gated: an entry is rendered only once `verified_at` is set by the liveness check (app/pipeline/fetch/ballot_lookup.py). Unverified or missing entries fall back to the national directory, which is stable and maintained by USAGov.

national_fallback.label: Find your state or local election office
